Why No Capitalization on God/Christ’s Possessive Pronouns?. This might seem like a small thing and maybe it is but I think it’s important. Whenever referring to God or Jesus Christ, all pronouns should be capitalized. “My”, “Me”, “Mine”, “Myself”, “Him”, “His”, “Himself”, “You”, “Yours”, “Yourself”, etc the first letter should always be capitalized when referring to God the Father or His Christ. Not sure why many people don’t seem to do that or whether it’s just an unintentional oversight or something else but it’s important to distinguish between God and Christ vs. anyone else. Maybe someone could fix that on the app and then I’d be happy to give it 5 stars and recommend more people to get it. God bless.
